hero.title: Siargao surf this week
hero.subtitle: Small and friendly early in the week, a bigger swell from Thursday. Light offshore winds before 9am.

beginner.title: Jacking Horse
beginner.subtitle: 1 to 2 ft all week. Soft rolling waves next to Cloud 9, best at mid to high tide.

beginner.title: Quiksilver
beginner.subtitle: 2 to 3 ft, cleanest before 9am. Easy paddle out from the Cloud 9 area.

advanced.title: Cloud 9
advanced.subtitle: 3 to 5 ft from Thursday. Fast right-hand barrels, crowded at dawn.

advanced.title: Stimpy's
advanced.subtitle: 4 to 6 ft lefts on the outer reef. Go with a local boatman and a buddy.

items.label: Boat to the outer reefs, per person

note.title: Respect the reef
note.body: Cloud 9 and Stimpy's break over shallow reef. Wear reef booties, never surf them at low tide, and stay out of the lineup at Cloud 9 if you are still learning.
note.author: From a Siargao surf coach
